title: Completion of a strict henselization is flat
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local ring and let R^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a chosen separable closure of the residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For the maximal-ideal completion \widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}=\varprojlim_n R^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}})^n, the canonical map R^{\mathrm{sh}}\to\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}} is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: Unpack IsStrictHenselization to obtain its universal cocone and algebra isomorphism to C. Extend the cocone by that isomorphism. Apply lem-sc-pointed-etale-small-filtered and whisker with its small-model equivalence to obtain a small filtered algebra diagram whose colimit vertex is C.

Forget to commutative rings using commAlgCatEquivUnder followed by Under.forget. These preserve the filtered colimit. For each stage, lem-sc-pointed-etale-completion-stage-flat gives flatness of the coprojection followed by the completion map.

Compare the resulting cocone with the chosen categorical colimit by its unique ring isomorphism E. The coprojection equations show that completion composed with E inverse is flat by lem-weil-pbc-colimit-rings-flat. Compose with E, whose ring map is flat because it is bijective, and cancel E inverse composed with E to recover the desired completion map.
